feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
entry.summary: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.

entry.title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
entry.summary: Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, and the results remain too close to call. And, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak was first declared in May.

entry.title: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
entry.summary: The toll is rising after a high-speed train between slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped south of Madrid, derailing two cars. It was Spain's second major train accident this year.

entry.title: Trump's relationship with Putin comes under fire ahead of the midterms
entry.summary: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is under scrutiny again as the president makes deals with Moscow ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: Partial results from Israel's contentious election show no clear winner
entry.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc was leading opposition rival Gadi Eisenkot. Arab parties had a strong showing, and a key question now is whether Eisenkot's bloc will consider forming a coalition with them.

entry.title: Ex-Israeli diplomat calls opposition's refusal to work with Arab parties 'reckless'
entry.summary: Why a stronger showing for Arab parties may not translate into political power in Israel.

entry.title: A U.S. cruise ship suspends a global voyage due to fuel costs, stranding 200 passengers
entry.summary: A U.S. cruise ship on an around-the-world voyage that touted its cabins as floating homes suspended its three-year journey in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark.

entry.title: Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in Florida after fleeing Brazil
entry.summary: Brazil's defeated candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in the U.S. after a multi-country journey as Washington says it will issue him a visa.

entry.title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
entry.summary: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

entry.title: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
entry.summary: The current outbreak, first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now counted 10,000 patients and has spread with great speed. How can it be stopped?
